1.0.0.title: Cliprr 1.0.0
notes: Includes the live Twitch monitor workflow for short-form clipping.
Adds the dashboard, learning, longform, and settings surfaces into the packaged app.
Supports Twitch user auth, Twitch chat auth, and multi-account Google upload configuration.
Fixes packaged runtime path resolution for VOD analysis and processed data output.
Improves Twitch token refresh handling for longer sessions and clearer auth state reporting.
Fixes startup behavior that could replay older clips as new session activity.
Improves learning rule visibility, title-scoring guidance, and dashboard reporting.
Improves the watchlist dock, settings flows, and packaged app stability.
